exam.title: AWS Certified Advanced Networking - Specialty
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal certification prerequisite; AWS targets candidates with five or more years of networking and two or more years of cloud/hybrid networking. Practice packet-path analysis, routing/BGP, Direct Connect/VPN, multi-account/Region/VPC topologies, DNS, edge/load balancing/service insertion, automation, observability, performance, cost, filtering, audit and encryption. The exam retires December 31, 2026 and no replacement is announced.

review.notes: The current four-domain ANS-C01 guide was reconciled with every detailed domain page, non-exhaustive service list and live English lifecycle page. It records the extended December 31 retirement, superseded localized August date and absence of a named replacement. Three scenarios, eight safe labs and 42 original checks cover edge/DNS/load balancing, BGP/DX/VPN, multi-account/Region/VPC routing, IaC, packet troubleshooting, performance/cost, network enforcement/audit and in-transit encryption. All 16 URLs are cataloged; automated link totals are updated from source health. Current metadata is labeled and no recalled questions are used.
